declarations.docstring: A simple finite-dimensional general linear group representation satisfying the displayed auxiliary condition is equivalent to a uniquely parameterized displayed model.
A finite-dimensional general linear group representation satisfying the displayed auxiliary condition is equivalent to a finite direct sum of displayed models.
A simple finite-dimensional general linear group representation satisfying the displayed auxiliary condition is equivalent to some displayed model.
A simple submodule of a representation satisfying the displayed auxiliary condition is equivalent to some displayed model.
Given the displayed auxiliary condition and a linear functional, there exists an auxiliary map whose evaluation at each group element equals applying the functional after the action.
An auxiliary map satisfying the displayed evaluation identity intertwines the given representation with the displayed target action.
